guarantees.claim: For each share i, msg_data_masked[i] is assigned the bitwise XOR of msg_data[i] with the bitwise AND of {MsgWidth{cfg_msg_mask}} and static_mask.

assumptions.claim: static_mask and cfg_msg_mask must be configured so that static_mask is not all-zeros and cfg_msg_mask provides sufficient randomness to achieve effective data masking.
assumptions.cond: when the optimized masking scheme is intended to protect secret msg_data
assumptions.risk: If either static_mask is zero or cfg_msg_mask is fixed, msg_data_masked equals msg_data, exposing plaintext and defeating side-channel resistance.

uncertain_points.claim: It is unclear from the local RTL whether static_mask is guaranteed to be non-zero in all legal configurations. If it can be zero, the masking is effectively disabled, which may conflict with the 'optimized masking scheme' intent.
uncertain_points.cond: if static_mask is allowed to be zero
uncertain_points.risk: Plaintext msg_data would be passed to downstream logic without masking, potentially violating security requirements for side-channel protections.
